query:
delete from records_history h
        using (
            select id, tx_from
            from records_history
            where tenant_id = $1 and scope_id = $2 and tx_to <= $3
            order by tx_to
            limit $4
        ) due
        where h.tenant_id = $1 and h.id = due.id and h.tx_from = due.tx_from
